code_summary: Intended architecture: one independent SASRec model per category, with 96-dimensional embeddings, two causal Transformer blocks, two attention heads, dropout 0.3, learned item bias, and unchanged inference scoring. The proposed loss uses 2,048 shared uniform sampled negatives and a 2,048-token cap, always includes each sequence endpoint, and samples nonendpoint positions with balanced per-sequence quotas. It averages 50% endpoint loss and 50% an unbiased estimate of each sequence’s full positional mean loss across the batch. Training retains prefix augmentation, AdamW, warmup, gradient clipping, and validation-based selection of one checkpoint per category; no ensembles or checkpoint averaging.
